ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows triangle JKL, with vertex L at the top, J at the lower left, and K at the lower right, and point Q located inside the triangle. The figure draws perpendiculars from Q to the three sides, with the feet of the perpendiculars respectively P, M, and N, and uses right-angle marks to indicate perpendicularity. The figure also draws line segments connecting JQ, KQ, and LQ. The arc-shaped label near vertex L shows ∠JLQ as 26°, and the arc-shaped label near vertex K shows ∠LKQ as 29°. The problem gives that Q is the incenter of triangle JKL. Reasoning: Because Q is the incenter, JQ, KQ, and LQ are respectively the angle bisectors of the vertex angles of triangle JKL. Therefore half of ∠L is 26°, so ∠L = 2 × 26° = 52°; half of ∠K is 29°, so ∠K = 2 × 29° = 58°. The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, so ∠J = 180° − 52° − 58° = 70°. Also because JQ bisects ∠J, m∠QJK = 70° ÷ 2 = 35°.

raw_record.question_text: $Q$ is the incenter of $\triangle JKL$. Find $m\angle QJK$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as triangle JKL with Q inside and segments JQ, KQ, and LQ drawn from the vertices to the incenter. The image labels the angle between LJ and LQ as 26° and the angle between LK and KQ as 29°. From the text, use that Q is the incenter, so JQ, KQ, and LQ are the internal angle bisectors of triangle JKL. Therefore the full angle at L is 2·26° = 52° and the full angle at K is 2·29° = 58°. Use the triangle angle sum to get angle J = 180° − 52° − 58° = 70°. Since JQ bisects angle J, m∠QJK = 70°/2 = 35°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是三角形 JKL，顶点 L 在上方，J 在左下方，K 在右下方，点 Q 位于三角形内部。图中画出了从 Q 到三边的垂线，垂足分别为 P、M、N，并用直角标记表示垂直。图中还画出了连接 JQ、KQ、LQ 的线段。靠近顶点 L 的弧形标注显示 ∠JLQ 为 26°，靠近顶点 K 的弧形标注显示 ∠LKQ 为 29°。题目给出 Q 是三角形 JKL 的内心。
推理：因为 Q 是内心，所以 JQ、KQ、LQ 分别是三角形 JKL 各顶角的角平分线。因此 ∠L 的一半是 26°，所以 ∠L = 2 × 26° = 52°；∠K 的一半是 29°，所以 ∠K = 2 × 29° = 58°。三角形内角和为 180°，所以 ∠J = 180° − 52° − 58° = 70°。又因为 JQ 平分 ∠J，所以 m∠QJK = 70° ÷ 2 = 35°。
